title: papaver dubium var. bipinnatum
intro: Papaver dubium var. bipinnatum, commonly known as yellow poppy or silky poppy, is a plant species in the poppy family, Papaveraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation, which may be attributed to its therapeutic actions as a mild sedative and antispasmodic. The bioactive constituents of Papaver dubium var. bipinnatum include alkaloids, such as protopine and sanguinarine, which may contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the plant's effects and potential interactions with other substances.
